settings.name: Design Corner
settings.title: Hi I am an Architect and Interior Designer specializing in spatial planning, BIM-driven Revit projects, high-end visualization, product design, and dynamic motion graphics. I translate complex architectural concepts into immersive visual narratives, seamlessly integrating spatial ergonomics, precise material representation, and time-based digital media with rigorous BIM standards.

scifiPortal.termDesc: Photorealistic architectural visualizations, parametric designs, custom geometry node addons & cinematic motion animations.

_textOverrides.heroDesc: Hi I am an Architect and Interior Designer specializing in spatial planning, BIM-driven Revit projects, high-end visualization, product design, and dynamic motion graphics. I translate complex architectural concepts into immersive visual narratives, seamlessly integrating spatial ergonomics, precise material representation, and time-based digital media with rigorous BIM standards.
_textOverrides.aboutDesc: I am a professional architect and BIM Modeler  specializing in architectural Planning Designing & renderings, interior design visualization, product design, and motion animations. With a passion for bringing architectural visions to life, I create stunning photorealistic renders that help clients visualize their projects before construction begins.
_textOverrides.skillsSub: Cutting-edge tools I use to bring your vision to life
_textOverrides.workSub: A showcase of my best work across different domains
_textOverrides.gallerySub: All renders, animations and designs in one place
_textOverrides.serv1Desc: Complete architectural solutions from concept to documentation using Revit BIM technology.
_textOverrides.serv2Desc: Photorealistic renders and visualizations that bring your designs to life before construction.
_textOverrides.serv3Desc: Cinematic animations and architectural fly-throughs created with professional Blender workflows.

projects.title: Modern Hillside Villa & Cantilever Deck
projects.description: Contemporary two-story luxury residence designed with spatial ergonomics and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Features expansive floor-to-ceiling curtain glass, evening perimeter lighting, swimming pool deck, and timber acoustic cladding.

projects.title: Minimalist Waterfront Pavilion Villa
projects.description: Photorealistic architectural exterior visualization of an ultra-modern cantilevered villa with an integrated infinity pool, polished travertine walls, architectural louvers, and warm sunset illumination.

projects.title: BIM Commercial Tower & Structural Core
projects.description: Complete Revit BIM model coordination and architectural flythrough showcasing multi-story structural framing, MEP integration, double-glazed curtain walls, and spatial office ergonomics.

projects.title: Parametric Geodesic Pavilion 3D
projects.description: Interactive 3D parametric architectural sculpture developed with Blender Geometry Nodes. Demonstrates algorithmic tessellation, structural steel joinery, and dynamic daylight apertures.

projects.title: High-End Minimalist Penthouse Living Suite
projects.description: Bespoke interior visualization featuring acoustic fluted wall paneling, custom floating Italian marble cabinetry, concealed cove LED ambient strips, and tactile Boucle upholstery.

projects.title: Handcrafted Ornate Dining Table 3D
projects.description: Interactive 3D model of classic artisanal dining room furniture. Built with high-precision PBR wood grain shaders, carved cabriole legs, and realistic French-polish lacquer reflections.

projects.title: Nordic Lounge Velvet Armchair 3D
projects.description: Contemporary Scandinavian interior armchair with micro-fiber sheen fabric shaders, brushed matte black metal base, and ergonomic spatial positioning for high-end residential lobbies.

projects.title: Contemporary Double-Height Great Room
projects.description: Volumetric architectural interior rendering showcasing double-height exposed concrete beams, integrated kitchen island with waterfall quartz, and diffuse morning daylight through clerestory windows.

projects.title: Industrial High-Tech Headgear 3D Model
projects.description: High-detail industrial design prototype featuring multi-layered PBR metallic roughness, micro-scratches, emissive optical lenses, and complex curvature ergonomics.

projects.title: Aerodynamic Commercial Ventilation Fan
projects.description: Precision engineering motion design showing computational fluid dynamic airfoil blades, brushless motor housing, and rotational vibration dampening mechanisms.

projects.title: Ergonomic Vacuum Thermal Flask 3D
projects.description: Interactive 3D consumer product model featuring double-wall stainless steel vacuum insulation, textured silicone grip ring, and leak-proof cap mechanism.

projects.title: Generative Geometry Exhibition Poster Series
projects.description: Algorithmic visual poster created using vector mathematics and parametric curves. Designed for international architectural symposiums and digital fabrication conferences.

projects.title: MEP & HVAC Technical Walkthrough Animation
projects.description: High-fidelity architectural animation demonstrating mechanical building systems, ducted air distribution, ventilation risers, and structural plenum spaces.

projects.title: Architectural BIM Multi-Level Coordination Flythrough
projects.description: Smooth camera trajectory moving through multi-story architectural spaces, revealing sectional cuts, interior fitouts, and BIM component intelligence.

projects.title: 24-Hour Solar Study & Dynamic Shadows
projects.description: Accurate architectural solar simulation demonstrating daylight penetration, solar heat gain mitigation via facade louvers, and evening golden-hour ambiance.

projects.title: Mechanical Assembly & Kinematic Motion
projects.description: Precision mechanical motion design animating component exploded views, gear tooth engagement, and structural tolerance in real-time.

projects.title: Aerial Drone Cinematography & Site Integration
projects.description: Sweeping cinematic flyover illustrating the relationship between architectural topography, surrounding terrain, access roadways, and landscape design.

addons.title: ArchViz QuickTools Pro
addons.desc: Automated parametric wall generation, trim moldings, and photorealistic lighting studio setups for Blender Cycles & Eevee.

addons.title: Parametric Stairs & Railings
addons.desc: Interactive geometry-nodes generator for spiral, cantilever, and modern industrial staircases with dynamic balustrade controls.

addons.title: Cinematic Camera Rigs
addons.desc: One-click architectural flythrough rigs with smooth camera easing, drone pathing, target tracking, and rack focus presets.
